title.narrative: The United Republic of Tanzania strengthened community health coordination on service packages, sustainable financing, digitization, and human resources. Community Health Workers (CHWs) will deliver more than 300 services including curative care, malaria testing and management, HIV self-test distribution, disease surveillance, and nutrition. 9,560 CHWs were recruited and 44% commenced training.
